steps.title: The Map tab
steps.body: The Inspector on the right has three tabs: Inspector (what is selected), Map (terrain, sky, weather, music) and Project (title, start map, hero, first screen).

steps.title: Generate terrain
steps.body: The terrain generator builds a whole world from environments (forest, city, mountains, volcanoes…). Pick one or more, then Generate. New seed gives a different world with the same mix. Houses, trees and cars become assets you can move, smash and edit.

steps.title: Move the camera
steps.body: Drag in the map to orbit, right-drag (or Shift-drag) to pan, and use the wheel to zoom. On a touch screen: one finger orbits, two fingers pan and pinch. Home fits the whole map, F frames the selection.
steps.task: Orbit and zoom the camera, then press Next.
steps.tip: Home fits the map in view.

steps.title: Select an object
steps.body: With the Select tool (V), click an object to select all of it — a house, a tree. Alt-click selects a single brick, Shift-click adds to the selection. The Hierarchy on the left lists every object by type.
steps.task: Select a building (click it, or pick one in the Hierarchy).

steps.title: Recolor
steps.body: The Inspector shows what you selected: its bricks, position and colors. Click a swatch to recolor the whole selection. Asset instances are recolored after Unpack; loose bricks recolor directly. The Color paint tool (C) paints by clicking.
steps.task: Recolor some bricks (Inspector swatches or the Color paint tool).

steps.title: Place bricks
steps.body: Brick paint (B) places the brush brick where you click. Pick its shape and color in the dock below (Assets › Bricks); T turns it. Bricks must sit on studs and never overlap — the same rules as LEGO World v68.
steps.task: Place a brick with Brick paint (B).

steps.title: Erase
steps.body: The Erase tool (X) removes the brick you click (Shift removes the whole object). Bricks that hold others up are protected so the map never breaks.
steps.task: Erase a brick with the Erase tool (X).

steps.title: Undo and redo
steps.body: Everything you do is one undo step: placing, painting, generating a whole map. Ctrl Z undoes, Ctrl Shift Z redoes. The project saves itself to this device a moment after each change.
steps.task: Undo your last change (Ctrl Z or the Undo button).
